layout_description: Use three compact input cards in the top row, each pointing down to one broad controller card. The controller has three distinct downward outgoing arrows toward the lower operation cards. All operation cards point to a wide bottom cost ledger. A dashed outer loop returns the ledger feedback to the remaining-budget card. Keep controller and execution distinct: the controller chooses context operations and the execution model is fixed, not trained here. Do not display a mathematical optimization formula, performance curve, percentages or guaranteed savings. The ledger is descriptive accounting rather than a claim of measured improvement. White backgrounds and restrained blue borders throughout.

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 9-10pt.
Adhere to stroke hierarchy: containers 1.5pt, dividers 1.0pt, arrows 1.5pt.
NO icons, NO pictograms, NO emojis, NO 3D rendering.
Feedback loop arrows are DASHED. Main forward flow arrows are SOLID.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no decorative shadows.
source_excerpt: 三条路线形成可观察的反馈关系：状态表示决定可提出哪些恢复请求，恢复结果暴露表示遗漏及证据过期风险，调度依据这些反馈重新分配有限上下文。共同实验保持这一反馈链可追踪，既做分模块干预，也检查整条轨迹的最终操作结果。
